A '''Dianoga''' was present on [[Bracca]] during [[Clone Force 99]]'s [[Mission on Bracca|mission]] to remove their [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]]. It inhabited the murky [[Water|waters]] that sat beneath the wreckage of a [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (Clone Force 99)|decommissioned ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Battle Scars" />

The [[dianoga]] attacked [[Wrecker]] when he nearly fell into the contaminated water among the ''Venator''{{'s}} wreckage.<ref name="Battle Scars" />
